title: add-benchmark-lab-adaptive-batching-reporting-pipeline-v134
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds adaptive-batching reporting pipeline (v134) to benchmark-lab. New reporting metrics for adaptive batching heuristics and kernel-selection heatmaps. No user-facing API changes.
description:
Motivation: we've iterated on adaptive batching in the serving runtime and need a stable, repeatable reporting pipeline to capture per-workload batch size distributions, latency/cost tradeoffs, and kernel-selection heatmaps across variants. This PR adds versioned reporting (v134) for the benchmark-lab pipelines, integrates new exporters into the profiling baseline flow, and wires outputs to the reporting dashboard.

What this change does: - introduces a new reporting pipeline job `benchmark_lab.adaptive_batching.v134` - collects per-run histograms for batch sizes, request inter-arrival distributions, and sequence-length conditioned latency/cost - emits kernel-selection and quantization profile summaries for downstream kernel-selection profiling - adds transformation and aggregation steps to produce dashboard-ready JSON and CSV artifacts

Scope: changes primarily in `benchmark-lab` and `perf-canary` orchestration; small docs update in `redwood-docs`. No runtime codepath changes other than additional telemetry hooks (non-blocking).

Checklist: - [x] Implement data collectors and aggregators - [x] Add pipeline DAG and k8s job manifests - [x] Add unit/integration tests for transform steps - [x] Add end-to-end run to CI smoke pipeline - [x] Docs and release notes updated

Testing and validation: ran full benchmark-lab suite against representative workloads (chat, completion, embeddings) in the staging cluster. Verified: - histogram aggregation matches local reference harness - CSV/JSON artifacts import correctly into reporting dashboard - CI smoke detected intermittent S3 permission issue (fixed by updating IAM role on second run)

Backward compatibility: pipeline is additive and versioned (v134). Existing v* pipelines unchanged.

Related: Linear ENG-1345, PM-987. See earlier iterations: prs pr-813214 (v133) and pr-772321 (v130) for prior pipeline structure.

Notes for reviewers: focus on transform correctness and artifact schema compatibility with the dashboard ingestion code. The transforms include a small schema bump (added `kernel_profile.version`), please verify the dashboard ingestion handles the new field (it is backward-compatible).
